title: Make About dependencies and license information compact and scannable
description:
Problem: the continued visual-density review found `/about` dominated by a long third-party dependency table and a full license block. This is legitimate information, but it is presented as one long read-through surface, making package lookup, license review, and attribution scanning harder than necessary.

Desired outcome: About should keep legal/dependency information complete while giving users compact navigation, filtering, and progressive disclosure.

Scope:
- In scope: About page section navigation, dependency table search/filter, license-family grouping, collapsible full license text, external-link affordances, and responsive table/card behavior.
- Out of scope: changing license text, package metadata source of truth, or legal attribution content.

Acceptance criteria:
- Users can quickly find a package, license, or project URL without scrolling through the whole dependency table.
- Full license text remains available but does not dominate the first-pass view.
- The dependency/license layout stays readable at narrow widths without requiring horizontal scrolling.
- External project/license links are clear and keyboard accessible.

Validation:
- Capture `/about` before/after at narrow and desktop widths.
- Run focused browser checks for package search/filter, license expansion/collapse, and link accessibility.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 continued visual-density review: `/about` measured as a long dependency/license surface where the package table and full license text dominate scanning.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by turning `/about` into a compact workbench with package/license summary cards, dependency search, license-family filters, shorter project host links with full URL titles, and a collapsed native details block for the MIT license text. Added route-smoke coverage for About filtering, clearing, and license expansion. Evidence: `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/About.razor`, `MemorySmith.App/wwwroot/app.css`, `e2e/tests/route-smoke.spec.ts`. Validation passed: `dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo`; focused About route-smoke 1/1; full route-smoke 6/6 against `http://127.0.0.1:5099`. Note: an integrated-browser probe confirmed no horizontal overflow on the visible About page, but its Blazor input state was less reliable than the Playwright route-smoke browser run.
